label: Early copy-phase steps in short (L=3/4) sequences: outputs 1-2 of L=3, output 2 of L=4
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase (never in original or delimiter steps) and only on repeat-token inputs (in_first==0). Concentrated on short sequences: for L=3 it fires on nearly every step outputting original tokens 1 and 2 (precision 0.96 for that clause, ~68% of mass); the strongest activations are at L=3 recall_idx 2 (last output, input = orig(1)), with weaker activation at recall_idx 1. For L=4 it fires on only about a third of recall_idx 2 steps (the input is orig(1)), and not on recall_idx 1 or 3; what selects those L=4 cases was not identified, which is the main source of false positives. Roughly 11% of mass falls on scattered mid-to-late copy steps of long sequences (L=7-9, e.g. t=12, to_go 5) and is not captured. Token identity has only weak modulation (inputs j/p/b slightly higher; top examples start with c or q). Dev F1 0.59, mass recall 0.89.
